primary.exact_action: Register app + authorize OAuth + set FREELANCER_OAUTH_TOKEN in local .env (one-time, ~10 min)
primary.permission: OAuth grant on founder-owned account (MFA non-delegable)
primary.unlocks: 4 guarded proposals submit + buyer inbox monitoring + reply loop
primary.after: factory auto-submits, verifies, monitors, follows up with zero further asks

why_factory_cannot: account ownership, MFA, billing, identity checks are platform-enforced human actions; no legitimate technical substitute exists (proven across 30+ cycles)
